name: smwmusic-secret-of-mana-flight-into-the-unknown
title: Secret of Mana - Flight into the Unknown
description:
Flammie's Theme from Secret of Mana.
Quite fast paced and happy, with a touch of some eastern instrumentation. Since it is a flying-theme it could be used best in cloud/sky levels. But also athletic levels or some titlescreens (due to its very climatic opening) can be fitting.
